recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current FHIR core source and generated publication surfaces already satisfy FHIR-31714; follow-up is only needed if a future generator/build regression again expands clinical-patient.target beyond Patient.
issue_request: FHIR-31714 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction raised for R4B and applied for R5. It reported that the downloaded SearchParameter/clinical-patient resource had expanded SearchParameter.target to all resource types after FHIR-28219, while the target list should be limited to Patient.
initial_application: Jira comments state that target types needed to be limited to Patient and that the problem affected all reference SearchParameters whose targets were constrained. Local git history shows the R4B/R5 application commits a96b79e23a892164f261dcf4c7868ec1ef8023e2 and b9ee4c1747a9d505eec4b76c41e26d95c5dd6a30, both titled 'Ensure targets are declared on target-constrained SearchParameters - part of FHIR-31714', adding explicit target declarations across resource search-parameter bundles.
additional_context: FHIR-28219 established the underlying rule that common patient searches should resolve only Patient, using Patient-filtered expressions where needed. FHIR-32876 later reported the same all-resource clinical-patient target expansion and was recorded in FHIR-I minutes as a duplicate of FHIR-31714; it already has a combined-branch no-change audit commit. The Zulip implementer thread confirmed the problem was in generated/downloaded targets and noted that R4B looked correct after the fix, while a later current-build regression was suspected in 2023. Later FHIR-36674 common-registry alignment did not change the Patient-only target conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini; source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml lists the clinical-patient bases without asserting Group or all-resource targets; resource-level patient SearchParameters have no explicit non-Patient target values; and current build, R5, and R4B search-parameters.json downloads all return target ["Patient"] for SearchParameter/clinical-patient.

related_jiras.note: Established the Patient-only common patient search rule and the need for Patient-filtered expressions on non-patient elements.
Later Published issue reported the same clinical-patient all-resource target expansion and was treated by FHIR-I as a duplicate of FHIR-31714; already represented on the combined branch.
Later registry-alignment work added current patient-search bases to clinical-patient without changing the Patient-only target conclusion.
